verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents WebSDK permalinks that let applicants complete verification via a direct link, which supports an ops lead sending a one-off verification without engineering (sumsub-docs-17), and access-token/API docs suggest programmatic generation is also possible (sumsub-docs-14). However, there is no explicit evidence of a QR code option or of a dashboard-only, no-code workflow for generating these links, and other flows (SDK customization, webhooks) still emphasize API/engineering-driven setup (sumsub-docs-14, sumsub-docs-18). Missing for 10: explicit QR code generation feature, confirmation that ops (non-engineering) can generate/share the link from the dashboard without any API call.
